Phase B progress owns exactly progress JSON, event JSONL, parent log, and PID JSON under one O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW directory flock, validates canonical hash-chain/schema/binding/metadata/PID state read-only, and reconciles only an authoritative ordered checkpoint tail. Every profile-aware context/store/readiness/runtime entrypoint validates the selected allowlisted profile, carries its projected frozen config and identity through nested parsers/open/create/recovery calls, and rejects cross-profile artifacts before checkpoint mutation.
